name: Adapalene
description: Retinoid (vitamin A-like drug) put on the skin that binds retinoic acid receptors in the cell nucleus

status.usStatus: FDA approved; 0.1% gel over the counter

bullets: **Binds retinoic acid nuclear receptors,** not the cytosolic receptor protein
**Meaning for acne** of these findings is unknown, per the label

practical.halfLife: Mean 17.2 hours (range 7 to 51) after skin use
practical.pharmacokinetics: Low blood levels; mostly gone by 72 hours; biliary excretion
practical.soldAs: OTC 0.1% gel (Differin); prescription 0.3% gel, cream, combinations

regulatory.text: Authorised nationally in all 27 EU countries

references: FDA, Differin gel 0.3% prescribing information (DailyMed), Dec 2023
FDA, Prescription to Nonprescription Switch List, Jun 2026
Cunliffe et al., Br J Dermatol, adapalene vs tretinoin pooled analysis, Oct 1998
